title: Settlers smash foundations of Palestinian family's homes in West Bank
summary: Militant Israeli settlers smashed the foundations of two homes belonging to a Palestinian family in the West Bank on Thursday (November 26), after settler attacks prevented them returning to them in…

blocks.text: Militant Israeli settlers smashed the foundations of two homes belonging to a Palestinian family in the West Bank on Thursday (November 26), after settler attacks prevented them returning to them in defiance of an Israeli court order.
